boundaries.deny: Hard restrictions and applicable capability/execution denies dominate matching owner-scoped allows; final matched rule version and authority checked before effects.

boundaries.credential_content: Bounded structured fields, nested serialized JSON, quoted assignments and private-key/bearer markers require exact human review before remembered/model paths. boundaries.public_metadata: Recursive public matcher redaction preserves stored authority; exact references/digests remain inspectable.
boundaries.UI_lifecycle: Fresh inventory after unlock discards old observation; synchronous CAS and approval fences prevent duplicate requests; withdrawn scope visibly falls back once.
